Other damage rejected during state4 clocks9..12,13 clocks13..17,18/19 clocks9..13,14 clocks13..17,23 clocks11..15 except bypass; sleep still rejects. Awake ordinary damage delegates to shared cap/recovery/height gates. Safe teleport path posts EventHooks, loaded ground search, liquid/collision checks with rollback and EntityUtil synchronization; used by attack teleports. No AbstractFlameborn fall teleport. Attack update before parent tick. Cooldowns initially0, positive decrement; attackDelay2. Server ejects passengers except14/15/19, suppresses sneaking on passenger; forced target-only grab, fixed rider position(Y+3), no controlling passenger; dismount functions ignore requested destination and use relative own coordinates. Targets Player/golems/retaliation/AbstractChorusling, move3. Goal21 buckshot sample32%, strict(5,15), max/look28, delay and cooldown;22 max21/look10 or23 max/look26 then buckshotCD40. Goals with random nextInt()*100 comparisons retain signed 32-bit overflow and are not bounded50%/70% samples. Blocked or rejected hit clears success, shields independent acceptance. State15 first passenger annihilation damage8*config at21/45; server throw84 EntityThrownEntity ownerthis damage1/inertia1, velocity1, inaccuracy14-4*difficulty, destination15 ahead/Y+2 and startY+3; passenger binding preserved by projectile contract. State21 creates three SmallAnnihilationBombs18 atY+3, damage8/ownerthis/velocity1, inaccuracies15/0/30 minus4*difficulty; no producer config multiplier. State23 safe random target teleport10 range7/10 attempts. Ordinary SideAreaAttack strictly distance AND wrapped arc, excludes self/allies/Pursuer, base*PursuerDamageMutliplier, mobAttack except defined state15 annihilation; accepted sets hasHit, optional huge launch and STUN40amp1, shields independent. nextSideAreaAttack server OR-wrapped arc can bypass distance, hasHit overwritten by EACH recipient acceptance and false on empty selection; accepted disables recipient sneak.
